name: Human-level control through deep reinforcement learning
summary: Introduces the deep Q-network, which learns to play Atari 2600 games from pixels and the score with Q-learning, experience replay and a target network.

cited.version: Nature 518:529-533, a copy hosted for a Swarthmore course

name: Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction (second edition)
summary: Textbook of reinforcement learning: Markov decision processes, dynamic programming, Monte Carlo and temporal-difference methods, function approximation and policy gradients; Section 6.5 presents Q-learning.

name: Learning from Delayed Rewards
summary: PhD thesis that introduces Q-learning, a way of learning optimal control from delayed rewards by incremental dynamic programming.
venue: PhD thesis, King's College, University of Cambridge

name: Q-learning
summary: Proves that Q-learning converges to the optimal action values with probability 1, when every action is repeatedly sampled in every state and the action values are represented discretely.
